topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Framing
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the learning outcomes, and previews the key themes of cancer evolution and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Cell-Intrinsic Drivers of Clonal Fitness and Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how cell-intrinsic molecular alterations confer competitive growth advantages that drive clonal expansion in pre-neoplastic tissues.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the hierarchical organization of tumors and investigate the specific cell types capable of initiating neoplastic growth.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion and Stromal Dependency
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how microenvironmental cues and inflammatory signaling provide the necessary permissive conditions for tumor outgrowth and maintenance.

topics.label: Methodologies for Profiling Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the experimental, genomic, and spatial technologies used to investigate clonal dynamics and microenvironmental interactions in tumors.

topics.label: Integrative Multi-Factorial Model of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how intrinsic cellular properties, acquired alterations, and permissive tissue environments converge into a comprehensive evolutionary framework of cancer.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Next Session Preview
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
